Every case gives you the expression the sentence uses, the sentence itself, the evidence the document supplies, and -- where the sentence writes a name of it -- the component that name reaches.   mention -- what the code can tell about the expression's place in the sentence.
  anchors -- other sentences of this document that name this component. They fix what the name means in the document; they do not decide this sentence.
